Name: Stardew Valley Additional Areas
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the entrustment of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#00ffff]这是一个测试版本，有很多未完善的地方，还有和其他mod的兼容性尚未完全测试，如果你在游戏内遇到任何问题，都可以留言告诉我，我会第一时间解决！[/color]

[color=#00ff00]感谢[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/110631873]Drenciel[/url]，[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73079613]TheLimeyDragon[/url]对我的帮助！让我及时更改了错误，[/color]
[/size][color=#00ff00][size=4]感谢[/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/332424]PresetM[/url] 提供的德语翻译，感谢[/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/149657268]FurryChe[/url] 提供的韩语翻译，感谢[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/176695995]trashcan9[/url] 提供的英语翻译﻿[/size][/color]﻿﻿[/center]
[center]
[size=4][color=#00ffff]Many new locations have been added to Stardew Valley, including new hardwood pile areas, mining areas, forest areas, foraging areas, planting areas, fishing spots, new maps, and some secret areas waiting for you to discover, on new islands. There are 15 golden walnuts inside, can you find them? This is a beta version, there are many imperfections, and the compatibility with other mods has not been fully tested. If you encounter any problems in the game, you can leave a message and let me know, and I will solve it as soon as possible![/color]

[color=#00ff00]Thanks [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/110631873]Drenciel[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73079613]TheLimeyDragon[/url]﻿ for helping me! let me change the error in time
